description: Book one free time for a person, paid at the clinic. Give option_id, clinic_id, date and time from find_free_times, and the person's name and mobile number (practitioner_id and add_on_ids if chosen). Nothing is booked yet: a code goes to the person by SMS, and the answer has the price, the place and the cancellation notice. Tell the person these and that the clinic's terms apply, ask for the code, then call confirm_with_code.

add_on_ids.description: Add-on ids from get_booking_choices. Their minutes lengthen each time.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

date.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD) of a free time find_free_times returned.

guest_names.description: The other guests, for a treatment booked for several guests at once (party_size above 1).

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

note.description: A short note to the clinic in the person's words. Never health details.

package_id.description: A package_id from get_booking_choices: the visit is the first session of the package.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there by SMS.

practitioner_id.description: A practitioner free at that time; omit for the first one free.

time.description: The start (HH:MM) of a free time find_free_times returned.

name: book_appointment

booking.description: Tell the person this before asking for the code.

discount_nok.description: What a live offer takes off the price.

free_cancellation.description: false: the time is inside the notice, so a booking cannot be cancelled free.

payment.description: pay_at_clinic: the person pays at the visit.

terms_url.description: The clinic's terms the person accepts by giving the code.

treatment.description: The treatment as the clinic names it.

code_sent_to.description: The masked phone or email the code went to.

confirmation_id.description: Pass it to confirm_with_code with the code.

status.description: code_sent: ask the person for the code, then call confirm_with_code.

title: Book an appointment
